facts.fact: Ministry of Education figures reported by La Presse give about 1,115,000 pupils, 53 per cent of all pupils, as enrolled for the 2026/2027 school year on the web platform Vie scolaire at 20 August 2026, with enrolment fees paid for about 1,020,000 (49 per cent); the article does not say whether the school or the parent makes the entry.

The ministry's figures for Vie scolaire at 20 August 2026 are shares of pupils (53 per cent enrolled, 49 per cent with fees paid); the article gives no number or share of schools using the platform and does not separate primary from secondary.

The Vie scolaire portal was launched at the end of July 2026 as a single electronic space for school services, in which a parent links a citizen account to the pupil's file and follows the pupil's school data in real time.
The Ministry of Education runs the Vie scolaire portal at viescolaire.education.tn and publishes the enrolment figures from it as part of its follow-up of the 2026/2027 enrolment operation.
La Presse states that the Vie scolaire portal, launched at the end of July 2026, forms part of the education sector's digital transition strategy; the strategy is not named or dated.

systems.tiers: all pupils nationally for annual enrolment and fee payment; parents' space linked to the pupil's file; levels not stated

note: Classed emis on a per-pupil file and per-pupil annual enrolment held by the ministry; the article never says the school itself enters anything, and names no level, so no levels fact.
